$Comment: One frost stack on the hit target (used by the ray, the nova twice, and the iceberg). With AT_Ice_King_Warmth (the potion): only AT_Ice_King_Slow_Weak, no stacks. Otherwise: no stack -> Frost_1, Frost_N -> clear it and put Frost_N+1, Frost_4 -> clear it and freeze 4 s (the 5th hit; 8 s until 2026-10-21: too long). Chain of EffectCondition as vanilla Ability_ChargedShot_Cast (Charge_1 -> 2 -> 3); ClearEntityEffect with Entity as vanilla Dungeon_Goblin_Mace_Slam. 2026-10-21 (snow shell): nothing at all on a target that is frozen right now (AT_Ice_King_Freeze or the ultimate's AT_Ice_King_Freeze_Ultimate), not even the weak slow or the half-stack flag: the client drops an entity's active ModelVFX (Freeze's snow shell) whenever another effect is removed from it or a visual effect is renewed (Mob Battle finding, tested), even though the server still has the freeze on. The freeze guard after the freeze still gives only the weak slow. 2026-10-22 balance (picked after an art review, ice-king-balance-review.md): the 5th stack freezes 2.5 s (was 4) with the guard 7.5 s (was 9), still 5 s free after; vanilla freezes last 0.8-1.5 s and everything landed for sure during 4 s. 2026-10-22 (playtest: the king's attacks froze his own ice pillars, that must never happen; they may take damage, so the player can hide behind one, but never frost or freeze): targets with the marker AT_Ice_King_Frost_Immune (the pillar AT_Ice_King_Ice_Pillar and AT_Ice_King_Lightning_Stuck put it on themselves) skip the frost/freeze part; the damage still lands. 2026-10-22 (playtest: the immunity is against the freeze, not the slow; and the slow must not double up when it ends): the freeze guard no longer stops the stacking (it only skipped it, giving a 1.5 s AT_Ice_King_Slow_Weak instead): during the immunity hits still add frost stacks (Frost_1..Frost_4 replace each other, they never add up), but at Frost_4 the freeze step still asks for no guard, so a guarded player stays at Frost_4 (the strongest slow) until the guard ends; the next hit after it freezes. Frost-immune targets (ice pillars) still skip it all.

Next.$Comment: Freeze guard first (2026-10-21): while AT_Ice_King_Freeze_Guard is on (frozen, or the 5 s after) no stacks build up, only the mild slow. Without this a frozen player rebuilt Frost_1..4 during the freeze and the 5th hit froze him again right after the guard ended.
